class Student:
    def __init__(self, aId):
        self._id = aId
        self._Profs = []

    def setId(self, aId):
        self._id = aId
        return True

    def getId(self):
        return self._id

    def getProf(self, index):
        return self._Profs[index]

    def getProfs(self):
        return tuple(self._Profs)

    def numberOfProfs(self):
        return len(self._Profs)

    def hasProfs(self):
        return len(self._Profs) > 0

    def indexOfProf(self, aProf):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._Profs) if x is aProf), -1)

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfProfs():
        return 0

    def addProf(self, aProf):
        if any(x is aProf for x in self._Profs):
            return False
        self._Profs.append(aProf)
        if aProf.indexOfMyStudent(self) == -1 and not aProf.addMyStudent(self):
            del self._Profs[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._Profs) if x is aProf), -1)]
            return False
        self._Profs.sort(key=lambda x: x.getName())
        return True

    def removeProf(self, aProf):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._Profs) if x is aProf), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        del self._Profs[oldIndex]
        if aProf.indexOfMyStudent(self) != -1 and not aProf.removeMyStudent(self):
            self._Profs.insert(oldIndex, aProf)
            return False
        return True

    def delete(self):
        copyOfProfs = tuple(self._Profs)
        self._Profs.clear()
        for aProf in copyOfProfs:
            aProf.removeMyStudent(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "id:" + str(self.getId())
                + "]")
